minor.issue: pytest.mark.timeout still emits PytestUnknownMarkWarning — register the mark in pyproject/pytest.ini or install pytest-timeout.

action_items: Optional: register pytest.mark.timeout to silence the warning.
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectOverview.jsx is 545 lines — still readable, but the STATUS_PILL/SHARE_PILL maps + StepSummary helper could move to a sibling file if more states are added.

ProjectOverview computes `done` per step using project[step.outputKey] truthiness. Edge: if a backend response sets framing to an empty object {} but step still treated as not-done — fine for current shape, but if a future stage seeds empty objects this would silently mark DONE.
In editStep, window.confirm() is fine, but a stylized in-app modal (matching the brut aesthetic) would be a worthwhile P2 polish.
Login.jsx correctly removed Google button + GoogleGlyph + useRef. No dangling imports detected.

ProjectFlow header buttons are visible after page load — first render under fast nav can still flash. Already mitigated with proper waits in tests, but consider rendering header before fetching project.
